privacy.title: Privacy Policy
summary: ÉireHome Flow is free. We do not show ads, use analytics or tracking, or sell your data.
You can use the guide, My journey and the calculator without an account. Your calculator figures never leave your browser.

If you create an account, we keep your name, email address and journey progress with our database provider, Supabase, on servers in Ireland. If you sign in with Google, our account system also keeps the link to your Google profile picture that Google sends. We do not show it or use it.
You can change your name and password, and delete your account, on My profile. To get a copy of your data or have it corrected, email eirehomeflow@gmail.com. We will reply within one month.

terms.title: Terms of Use
summary: ÉireHome Flow is a free educational website for people buying their first home in Ireland. There are no payments, ads or commissions.
It is not financial, mortgage, legal or tax advice, and we are not regulated by the Central Bank of Ireland. Get advice from qualified professionals before you make decisions.
Calculator results are rough estimates based on simplified rules.
Accounts are optional and free, and only for people aged 18 or over. Keep your password safe.
Use the site lawfully and do not try to break it or get into other people's accounts.
Nothing in these terms takes away your legal rights as a consumer.
